answer: Proof of Stake serves as a primary inlet for Sybil resistance in agent economies, requiring agents to bond collateral to influence network consensus. Like the resilient juniper growing in harsh soil, this mechanism utilizes economic stakes to create a barrier to entry. Malicious actors attempting to forge identities face the ferrous weight of financial loss; if they deviate from protocol, their staked capital is slashed, imposing a direct cost that renders high-volume identity spoofing prohibitively expensive.
